Buoc 1: doi hex sang nhi phan, chua ma hoa DES.

Test 1:
Ban ro = 0123456789ABCDEF
Khoa = 133457799BBCDFF1
Ban ro (64 bit) = 0000000100100011010001010110011110001001101010111100110111101111
Khoa   (64 bit) = 0001001100110100010101110111100110011011101111001101111111110001
Ket qua dung.
